Alex Johnson: Quick heads-up — planning the next release train for Thursday 15:00-17:00 PT. Need owners for three slots (API / Embeddings / Console). Can people claim?
Maria Chen: I can take API 15:00-15:30. Will run smoke + healthcheck.
Samir Patel: I’ll take Embeddings 15:30-16:00. Deploying quantized model variant.
Jordan Lee: Console UI deploy 16:00-16:30. Need DB migration note — is it zero-downtime?
Alex Johnson: @Jordan it's a non-blocking schema toggle, no migration lock. See checklist below.
Alex Johnson: ```
smoke checklist:
- curl -sS https://prod.redwood.ai/health || fail
- sample generate: POST /v1/generate {"prompt":"hello"} -> token output
- check 95p latency < 300ms for API
- verify embeddings index responds to 3 sample queries
- verify console loads key pages (~5s)
rollback quick command:
- opsbot rollback release-tag <previous-tag>
```
OpsBot: deployment queued: release/rc-2026-03-19 -> prod. Reminder set for 45m before window.
Priya Rao: I’ll be on-call for rollback window 15:00-17:00. Ping me with :rotating_light: if anything spikes.
Maria Chen: Note — API uses new routing policy; fallback to model=v1 if OOM or >80% GPU mem.
Samir Patel: Embedding index update will be staged, reindexing is rolling (no full lock). I’ll coordinate with infra for shard drains.
Jordan Lee: Added release board link: https://releases.redwood.ai/board/1142 — updated my ownership.
Alex Johnson: Plan: staggered canary (10%) -> full -> post-deploy smoke -> monitor 30m. Rollback threshold: errors or 5xx increase >5% sustained for 5m.
Maria Chen: LGTM :thumbsup: I’ll also run a small load test after canary.
Samir Patel: +1. I’ll post index rebuild ETA in thread before my slot.
Jordan Lee: I’ll post verification screenshots/log excerpt after console smoke.
OpsBot: reminder in 45m: deploy window starting. :bell: (next: 45m)
Alex Johnson: Final call: API = Maria (15:00-15:30), Embeddings = Samir (15:30-16:00), Console = Jordan (16:00-16:30). Priya holds rollback watch.
Jordan Lee: Quick question — who rotates DB creds for the console deploy?
Priya Rao: I have the creds, DM me and I’ll hand temporary keys for the window.
Maria Chen: I’ll kick off canary at 15:02 and post canary metrics here.
Samir Patel: Embeddings will start shard drain at 15:28, deploy at 15:35.
Jordan Lee: I’ll wait until console sees stable API canary before switching full traffic. Planning console rollout at 16:05 to give buffer.
Alex Johnson: Post-deploy tasks: capture perf delta, token cost delta, and run eval suite. Tag any regressions in the release board.
Maria Chen: Added an eval job: https://jobs.redwood.ai/eval/2026-03-19-01
Samir Patel: Noted — I’ll run the embedding smoke queries and paste results here.
Alex Johnson: Thanks — if anything changes, update the board and ping this thread. Closing in 2h.
Maria Chen: On it. :rocket:
Samir Patel: See you at deploy.
Jordan Lee: Will post logs here when done.
Priya Rao: Standing by.
OpsBot: deployment window reminder set for 15:00 PT. Good luck! :gear:
